description: Auditable boundary between Agent Core and runtime packages.

requiredPackages.name: aura-system
requiredPackages.capability: runtime app and UI contribution discovery

requiredPackages.name: governance
requiredPackages.capability: tool action authorization and approval claims

requiredPackages.name: hermes
requiredPackages.capability: mobile cloud LLM model discovery and requests

requiredPackages.name: mcp
requiredPackages.capability: MCP provider catalog and client configuration

requiredPackages.name: memory
requiredPackages.capability: long-term facts, recall and feedback memory

requiredPackages.name: specialists
requiredPackages.capability: agent-file discovery and per-session specialist resolution

requiredPackages.name: ui-schema
requiredPackages.capability: structured UI schemas emitted by the agent

optionalPackages.name: cognitive-engine
optionalPackages.capability: optional cognitive observations and local decision experiments
optionalPackages.integration: package UI and event hooks only
optionalPackages.whenAbsent: tool and skill prioritization remain owned by classification

optionalPackages.name: android-device
optionalPackages.whenAbsent: chat continues without Android context or action traces

optionalPackages.name: bags
optionalPackages.whenAbsent: session list remains available without progress metadata

optionalPackages.name: variants
optionalPackages.whenAbsent: variant tools return an explicit unavailable error

optionalPackages.name: ntfy
optionalPackages.whenAbsent: notification opt-in is hidden while chat remains available
